definitions.gloss: youth; young people; adolescents and young adults
definitions.explanation: A collective term for young people, typically ranging from adolescents to those in their early twenties. Often used in official, legal, or institutional contexts.

examples.japanese: {青少年|せいしょうねん}の{育成|いくせい}に{力|ちから}を{入|い}れている。
examples.english: We are putting effort into nurturing young people.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}は{青少年|せいしょうねん}に{悪影響|あくえいきょう}を{与|あた}える{恐|おそ}れがある。
examples.english: This movie may have a bad influence on young people.

examples.japanese: {地域|ちいき}の{青少年|せいしょうねん}{育成|いくせい}{団体|だんたい}がボランティア{活動|かつどう}を{行|おこな}っている。
examples.english: A local youth development organization is carrying out volunteer activities.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat formal term used in official, educational, and media contexts. Combines {青年|せいねん} (young adult) and {少年|しょうねん} (boy/adolescent) to cover a broad age range. Commonly appears in laws, regulations, and organizational names.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {青少年|せいしょうねん}{育成|いくせい} (youth development)
- {青少年|せいしょうねん}{保護|ほご} (youth protection)
- {青少年|せいしょうねん}{犯罪|はんざい} (juvenile crime)
- {青少年|せいしょうねん}{健全|けんぜん}{育成|いくせい}{条例|じょうれい} (youth healthy development ordinance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {若者|わかもの}: young people — casual and conversational
- {少年|しょうねん}: boy, juvenile — narrower age range, typically under 18
- {青年|せいねん}: young adult — typically late teens to mid-twenties
